why: Every major reviewer in the results (Tom's Guide, TechRadar x3, IT Pro) is a monitor roundup or monitor review that merely mentions built-in KVM; none tests standalone KVM switches at 4K 144Hz. The only pages that address the 144Hz constraint are three affiliate listicles (consumercarts, dattatecblog, deskgearhq) with spec-sheet picks or uncheckable testing claims, and the rest cap at 4K@60Hz or are a retailer listing. A focused page comparing DP 1.4 / TB4 KVMs on verified 4K 144Hz with a Mac, EDID handling and current prices would stand out.
